source_review.observation: The allowed predicate admits anthropic-live only with available=true and external_transmission=true, and contract-fake/contract-live-test only with external_transmission=false. The provider badge applies the same mode/flag pairing.
source_review.consequence: A configured actual branch is represented without treating malformed actual/fixture flag combinations as enabled. Configured is not represented as verified account, successful invocation, or confirmed invoice.

source_review.observation: Bounded loopback and actual modes require both per-round and total cost caps. Submission validates positive six-decimal micro amounts and total>=round, and sends total_maximum_micro. A rights checkbox and exact manifest remain required before approval; no automatic approval or retry was introduced.
source_review.consequence: The UI no longer omits the total budget required by the server contract.

source_review.observation: The admitted actual panel is placed before the manual guided brief and legacy panel is hidden. Default non-actual placement keeps the legacy panel available. Layout movement is guarded by changed live status. Stable workspace/project/conversation draft keys preserve a newly typed prompt across revision-only refreshes.
source_review.consequence: The model workflow is reachable first without forcing revision-only polling to reset a new prompt.

source_review.observation: An absent or unpriced cost is displayed as unconfirmed usage amount. A priced amount or proven message_status=not_sent may display a known zero. Billing confirmation is presented separately.
source_review.consequence: Placeholder zero is not displayed as confirmed free usage; a known pre-message block can truthfully show zero while retaining prior round usage and unconfirmed billing.

source_review.observation: Dynamic model, destination, prompt, answer, errors, payload JSON, IDs, and tool labels used in innerHTML flow through esc; capability and status text use textContent. Generic innerHTML hook matches are insufficient to establish an XSS path.
source_review.consequence: No concrete unescaped dynamic-text path was found in the reviewed changes. This is a bounded source review, not a comprehensive penetration test.

source_review.observation: generalChatChanged now compares production_runs, so a terminal run-only transition adopts the fresh revision and refreshes general chat. Existing epoch/sequence, busy/dirty, workspace/project/shot, older-revision, and in-flight guards remain. The same-scope general refresh retains new prompt text.
source_review.consequence: The observed terminal-run-only stale revision has an implemented convergence path without a global draw reset. Real plan producers also update active_conversation, so chatChanged redraws proposal cards.

ce_review.Poisoning: Provider/answer/error text is treated as escaped data in reviewed UI sinks. Synthetic evidence is explicitly separate from actual Claude evidence.
ce_review.Distraction: Changes remain within capability admission, consent/cost truth, and polling convergence; no unrelated redesign or source changes by reviewer.
ce_review.Confusion: Configured, count observed, message sent/not_sent/unknown, usage estimate, and invoice confirmation are not merged. Historical failed logs are not current failures.
ce_review.Clash: Current source and reachable producer state overrule filename assumptions and an incomplete VM state. Earlier claims are retained with explicit corrections.
